edge_sample.source_text: definition Decomposition Group: The decomposition group of $L/K$ is the subgroup \[\{\sigma\in\Gal(L/K)\mid \sigma(\mathcal{O}_L) \subset \mathcal{O}_L\}\] of $\Gal(L/K)$
edge_sample.target_text: theorem : If $\sigma\in\Gal(L/K)$ lies in the decomposition group of $L/K$, then \[i_{L/K}(\sigma) = \infty\iff s = 1.\]

edge_sample.source_text: definition Lower Index: The lower index of $\sigma\in\Gal(L/K)$ is \[i_{L/K}(\sigma) := \begin{cases} \infty, &\sigma = 1,\\ , &\sigma\ne 1. \end{cases}\]
edge_sample.target_text: theorem : If $\sigma\in\Gal(L/K)$ lies in the decomposition group of $L/K$, then \[i_{L/K}(\sigma) = \infty\iff s = 1.\]
